title: Replication package: Lineage Diversity and Metadata-Defined Option Survival in the Hugging Face Model Supply Chain
description: Code, derived results, validation protocols, and documentation for a study of counterfactual upstream-model removal on the Hugging Face model lineage graph (snapshot 2026-09-25, 3,094,856 models). Includes the revised analyses, the rerun of the initially planned analysis, matched-null sensitivity analyses, and generators for all paper and supplement tables. The raw snapshot and processed graph tables are archived in a separate Zenodo dataset record. Cleaning flags are heuristics, not judgments about uploaders; account names in example IDs are pseudonymized.
